text_block_list.text:
Nishino Flower was injured during 
training, so we rushed over to the 
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...It seems to be in worse shape than we 
thought..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, I know it's probably impossible, 
but I still have a favor to ask..."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I want to become an Umamusume who can give 
courage to so many people. I can't let an 
injury stop me.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it's just within my limits... 
could we please do some training...?!"
choice_data_list:
You really shouldn't push yourself so 
hard.
Okay, let's figure out what we can do.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
“Still, while I was resting, everyone else 
was moving forward...”
choice_data_list: Pushing yourself too hard isn't courage.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I'm sorry... I just felt like I was 
being left behind...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No rushing here... right? I'll stay quiet 
until it heals...

Sounding a little disappointed, Nishino 
Flower headed back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Thank you very much! I'll do my 
best!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, it still seems to hurt...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'll give up on training for a while...

Looking like she was in pain, Nishino 
Flower slowly walked back to the dorms.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! It feels like light exercise 
should be fine!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I'll do my best within my limits for now!

With a fulfilled look on her face, Nishino 
Flower agreed and did a light training 
session while being mindful of her injury.
